import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# Disable progress bars
pd.set_option("display.progress_bar", False)
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data from correct location
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Prepare features and target
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["Cover_Type"].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Create hold-out validation split
val_ratio = 0.2
n_samples = len(X_train)
n_val = int(n_samples * val_ratio)

# Set seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)
indices = np.random.permutation(n_samples)
val_indices = indices[:n_val]
train_idx = indices[n_val:]

X_train_final = X_train.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
X_val = X_train.iloc[val_indices].reset_index(drop=True)
y_val = y_train.iloc[val_indices].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train_final)}")
print(f"Validation samples: {len(X_val)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(X_test)}")

# Train Random Forest classifier on training data only
rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=15,
    min_samples_split=10,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

rf_model.fit(X_train_final, y_train.iloc[train_idx])

# Evaluate on held-out validation set (never seen during training)
val_predictions = rf_model.predict(X_val)
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"\nValidation Accuracy: {validation_accuracy:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_predictions = rf_model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file with required format
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_predictions})

# Save to correct path
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
